question: Under footnote *5, is Total Residual Chlorine (TRC) monitoring required—and is the 19 ug/L effluent limit applicable for compliance comparison—only during periods when chlorine is used within the treatment plant?
semantic_arguments: Full text of footnote *5, which conditions TRC monitoring on chlorine use for disinfection, equipment cleaning, maintenance, or any other purpose
TRC row in the Part I limits table listing Daily measurement frequency and a 19 ug/L limit with footnote *5 reference
Statement in footnote *5 that the facility uses ultraviolet disinfection
Evidence of whether and when chlorine was used within the treatment plant during Federal FY2025
notes: Footnote *5 makes TRC monitoring conditional on chlorine use while the limits table lists Daily frequency; resolving whether monitoring and limit applicability are chlorine-use-dependent changes which measurements require limit comparison (Purpose A), which monitoring obligations apply (Purpose B), and how to classify missing TRC data (Purpose C).
